content.text:
Create one Gmail filter on the signed-in Google account in this box's Chrome.

Open this URL directly: https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#settings/filters

If you land on a Google login page and cannot proceed without a password or 2FA, STOP immediately and report that sign-in is required. Do not invent credentials.

If already signed in to Gmail (prefer tyson.goulding@optconnect.com if multiple accounts):
1. On Filters and Blocked Addresses, click Create a new filter (or Create filter).
2. Set criteria exactly:
   - From: no-reply-ops@lattigo.com
   - Has the words: Push Handler
3. Click Create filter (the button that advances to actions).
4. Check these actions:
   - Skip the Inbox (Archive it)
   - Mark as read
   - Apply the label: NOISE (existing label)
   - Apply the label: lattigo (existing label) if a second label can be applied; if the UI only allows one label, use NOISE.
   - Also apply filter to matching conversations, if shown.
5. Confirm/create the filter.
6. Verify it appears in the filter list with From no-reply-ops@lattigo.com and words Push Handler.

Do not change any other filters. Do not send or delete mail.

Report back: success or failure, the exact filter criteria/actions saved, whether you were signed in as tyson.goulding@optconnect.com, and if sign-in is needed.
I'll open the Gmail filters settings.
